column1: # Row classifications for the platform-boundary ledger (#975, phase 9).
# "Zero baseline" means zero UNCLASSIFIED rows, not a literal zero: every row
# that survives consolidation must say why it stays. One line per ledger
# identity (all ordinals of that path/kind/construct share the class).
#   host-test  a test or fixture that asserts real host behaviour
#   compat-4x  published 4.x surface; the note must name its 5.0 retirement
#   artifact-format  host selection by artifact format (PDB vs object/DWARF reader,
#              unwinder per arch); only valid in the probe artifact crates
# Kept beside the ledger, not in it: the Dylint lint include_str!s the ledger
# and skips any row that does not have exactly four fields.
